# Attribution Template for awesome-copilot Content

This template should be included at the top of any file that uses content or patterns from the awesome-copilot repository.

## Template Format

```markdown
<!-- Based on patterns from: https://github.com/github/awesome-copilot -->
```

## Usage

1. Add this attribution comment at the top of any instruction, prompt, or chatmode file that uses awesome-copilot patterns
2. Replace the generic URL with the specific file URL if adapting from a specific awesome-copilot file
3. Attribution maintains proper licensing and credit for the awesome-copilot community

## Examples

### Generic Attribution (multiple patterns)

```markdown
<!-- Based on patterns from: https://github.com/github/awesome-copilot -->
```

### Specific File Attribution

```markdown
<!-- Based on: https://github.com/github/awesome-copilot/blob/main/instructions/csharp.instructions.md -->
```

```markdown
<!-- Based on: https://github.com/github/awesome-copilot/blob/main/prompts/expert-dotnet-software-engineer.chatmode.md -->
```

## License Note

awesome-copilot is released under MIT License. By using this attribution template, we:

- Properly credit the awesome-copilot community
- Maintain license compliance
- Enable one-time copy strategy with clear provenance
